# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
From the records, determine where and when excessive emissions have occurred.
3. Decide on the most appropriate primary indicator to estimate the tonnage of the emission. Determine which threshold $k$ this emission event matches best.
4. Using the indicator-type equation (or table) from Table 11.1 (or equation type), estimate the tonnage of the emission, $f(k)$, where the ‘input variable’ is the threshold, as shown in the expression “ $\dot{E}_{r,j}=f(k)$.”
